content:
ana_sales: Hey team — Glacier Edge just uploaded a SIG/CAIQ and asked for a security review before our final SOW. POC kickoff scheduled for Tue. Can someone claim this and give an ETA for answers?

matt_support: I can help compile answers if we have an owner to sign off on technical controls.

rachel_security: I can own the questionnaire. Quick Qs first: is this for Hosted API or Private deployment? Any BYOK/HSM requirement called out?

ana_sales: They prefer Private (VPC) and explicitly asked about BYOK + audit logs. Also asked for SOC2 evidence and encryption details. Customer says timelines are tight — wants answers by EOD tomorrow.

rachel_security: Ok assigning to me. Can you drop the doc link and the exact list of sections they flagged as "high priority"?

ana_sales: Link: https://redwoodinternal.docs/glacier-edge/sig-uploads/1768504321 - flagged: KeyMgmt, DataRetention, IncidentResponse, AccessControls.

devsec-bot: New intake created for ticket REDWOOD-SEC-4821 (assigned to rachel_security). Please attach any evidence to the ticket.

rachel_security: Thanks. Need these from the POC team to finish answers:
```text
- Current deployment options (hosted/dedicated/private) and any config differences
- KMS integration options and sample config (BYOK steps)
- Which logs are available in the Console and retention windows
- Data flow diagram indicating where customer data touches our runtime/KV cache
- SOC2 report link or attestation
```

poc_engineer: I'll produce the dataflow diagram and KMS how‑to by EOD. Quick note: BYOK for Private requires a partner HSM config; I'll attach a sample command block.

poc_engineer: ```bash
# sample BYOK rotation step (prod)
redwoodctl kms import --key-id=glacier-byo --source=hsm://partner --env=private
```

matt_support: For pricing implications — if they require Private + BYOK + 13mo retention for logs, expect an uplift. Rough estimate: +15–25% on the Dedicated commitment and additional storage. I can get a more formal number if sales needs.

ana_sales: We probably need an estimate for the SOW. Matt, can you do a quick commit uplift estimate by noon?

matt_support: Yep, will drop a short calc in the ticket and ping here.

rachel_security: I'll start drafting SIG answers. If anyone has example language for KMS/BYOK (customer-facing), paste it here. Otherwise I'll reuse the standard private-deploy template.

ana_sales: Thx — if you can mark any answers as "needing legal review" I'll hold off sending to the customer until we have signoff.

rachel_security: Will do. Plan: draft by 5pm, hand to legal if needed, final to sales owner by EOD tomorrow.

devsec-bot: Reminder: attach evidence to REDWOOD-SEC-4821 and add the tag `glacier-edge` for tracking.

ana_sales: Great — owner assigned and timeline set. I'll update the customer: expecting formal answers + evidence links within 36 hours. :thumbsup:

poc_engineer: Uploaded dataflow and sample KMS steps to the ticket (link above).

matt_support: Pricing note posted in REDWOOD-SEC-4821 — preliminary +18% uplift for Private+BYOK. I'll refine tomorrow.

rachel_security: Draft done and pushed to the ticket; marked two questions for legal (`encryption-certification`, `third-party-audit`). Will follow up with legal now.

ana_sales: Thanks all. I'll close the loop with Glacier Edge and keep the thread updated if they escalate. :pray:
